title: Outdoor film evening
brief: The original delivery of two flight cases of folding projection screens to park gatehouse has fallen through. The film society needs a replacement shipment in time for the daylight screen check. This is a single, indivisible load. Team up to book a replacement service today.

turns.speaker: Ari
turns.text: Let’s book a replacement today for both flight cases of folding projection screens, traveling together to the park gatehouse. Robin, when can they be ready for pickup? Lee, when can you receive them, and what’s the latest arrival that leaves time for the daylight screen check? Morgan, please confirm a service that fits and send me the all-in quote before booking. I can approve up to 96 crowns total.

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text: I can guarantee a staffed handover at the park gatehouse through 11:30 today. Both flight cases need to arrive together, and we can’t accept an unattended drop. Robin, when can both cases be ready for pickup? Morgan, can you quote a service that guarantees handover by 11:30? Ari, please confirm what we can spend so we can book it.

turns.speaker: Morgan
turns.text:
I have four all-in quotes for both cases together. Each lists pickup time, guaranteed staffed handover time at the gatehouse, and price in crowns.

V722 picks up at 09:56, handover by 11:12, 49 crowns.  
V189 picks up at 10:04, handover by 11:08, 78 crowns.  
V307 picks up at 10:09, handover by 10:53, 110 crowns.  
V875 picks up at 10:18, handover by 11:48, 40 crowns.

Robin, when can both cases be ready? Lee, what’s your staffed handover window for the screen check? Ari, what spend can you authorize? I’ll book the lowest-priced service that fits.

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text: I can release both packed flight cases from 09:45 today. They must travel together. Lee, when can the gatehouse receive them, and what’s the latest arrival that leaves time for the daylight screen check? Morgan, can you quote a service for the whole load and give us pickup and arrival times? Ari, can you confirm the budget?

Robin, please commit to the 09:56 release. Lee, please confirm staffed receipt by 11:12. Ari, please approve the 49 crowns. If anything blocks booking, please flag it now.
